threads.body: [Testing] The cache-token getters also apply to `ConverseStream`, but the added test only exercises synchronous `Converse`. This leaves cache-token deserialization from streaming metadata and emission at span completion unverified. Please add a shared streaming integration case asserting both cache attributes for library and javaagent instrumentation, including latest-dependency coverage and absence on older SDKs.

replies.body: Added a ConverseStream case in 02f55e70fc. It runs in both the library and javaagent suites and checks the attributes are present on the latest SDK and absent on 2.25.63.
